newsitem.title: USA: Woods named chairman of two Phila. port agencies.
newsitem.headline: Woods named chairman of two Phila. port agencies.

text.p: Pennsylvania Gov. Tom Ridge said he named David Woods chairman of Philadelphia Regional Port Authority and Port of Philadelphia and Camden Inc.
Woods, chief of staff to Pennsylvania state Senate Majority Leader Joseph Loeper, replaces Paul Zelenkofske at the Regional Port Authority and Michael Facemyer at Port of Philadelphia and Camden.
Regional Port Authority manages Pennsylvania's maritime cargo handling facilities along the Delaware River. Port of Philadelphia and Camden supervises a port unification in the region.

"I truly believe that the region must treat transportation as an interdependent network," Woods said in a statement. "Highway, rail, air, and maritime activity should be coordinated to promote regional growth."

New Jersey Gov. Christine Whitman last week issued a conditional veto of legislation to unify the ports of Philadelphia and Camden, urging lawmakers to delete provisions giving legislative leaders a say in naming members to the boards.
